name: Pashirare Biyori
source:
During lunchtime, as I was about to eat my bento box alone, a delinquent classmate approached me.
"Go buy me some food from the school store."

You can either obediently run the errand or refuse!
translation:
午饭时间，当我正准备一个人吃便当时，一位不良同学向我走来。
“去学校商店给我买点吃的吧。”

你要么乖乖跑腿，要么拒绝！
